* Interface define calculators of K values for DSA/ECDSA.
 * @hide This class is not part of the Android public SDK API

methods.name: boolean isDeterministic()
methods.comment:
* Return true if this calculator is deterministic, false otherwise.
     *
     * @return true if deterministic, otherwise false.

methods.name: void init(BigInteger n, SecureRandom random)
methods.comment:
* Non-deterministic initialiser.
     *
     * @param n the order of the DSA group.
     * @param random a source of randomness.

methods.name: void init(BigInteger n, BigInteger d, byte[] message)
methods.comment:
* Deterministic initialiser.
     *
     * @param n the order of the DSA group.
     * @param d the DSA private value.
     * @param message the message being signed.

methods.name: BigInteger nextK()
methods.comment:
* Return the next valid value of K.
     *
     * @return a K value.

methodNames: void init(BigInteger n, BigInteger d, byte[] message)
